# Cady Tianyu Xu - Personal Website

> This is the personal academic portfolio of Cady Tianyu Xu, a researcher at Google DeepMind working on LLM agents and multimodal AI.

## About Cady Xu

Cady Tianyu Xu is a researcher at Google DeepMind. Her work focuses on multimodal LLM agents that move beyond open-ended generation toward closed-loop execution, bridging the gap between high-level reasoning and autonomous task completion in real-world environments. Previously, she was a machine learning engineer on the Google XR team, developing perception models and multimodal LLMs for immersive, context-aware interaction. Her recent work spans multimodal human-centered systems and interactive AI, with publications at UIST and CHI. She holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Political Science from UC Berkeley.

## Research Interests

- Large Language Model (LLM) Agents
- Multimodal AI and Machine Learning
- Extended Reality (XR) and Spatial Computing
- Audio-Visual Perception and Interaction
- Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)

## Selected Publications

### MoXaRt (CHI 2026)
Audio-Visual Object-Guided Sound Interaction for XR. A real-time XR system that uses audio-visual cues to separate sound sources and enable fine-grained sound interaction. Authors: Tianyu Xu et al.

### SAMOSA (UIST 2025)  
Enhancing XR Auditory Realism via Multimodal Scene-Aware Acoustic Rendering. An on-device system that renders spatially accurate sound by dynamically adapting to physical environments. Authors: Tianyu Xu et al.

### EI-Lite (UIST 2025)
Electrical Impedance Sensing for Micro-gesture Recognition and Pinch Force Estimation. A lightweight wrist-worn device for micro-gesture recognition. Authors: Junyi Zhu, Tianyu Xu et al.

### Steerable Chatbots (arXiv 2025)
Personalizing LLMs with Preference-Based Activation Steering. Lightweight LLM personalization via activation steering. Authors: Jessica Y. Bo, Tianyu Xu et al.

### CaliPSo (ICML 2025 Workshop)
Calibrated Predictive Models with Sharpness as Loss Function. Neural network model for uncertainty quantification with marginal calibration. Authors: Alexandre Capone, Kamron Zaidi, Tianyu Xu et al.

### Liquid EIT (ICRA 2024)
Liquids Identification and Manipulation via Digitally Fabricated Impedance Sensors. Robot sensing for liquid manipulation. Authors: Junyi Zhu, Young Joong Lee, Yiyue Luo, Tianyu Xu et al.
